_note: v2.8 19, the open opening of an anchor, in a group chat, no model. Player lines are /send compact, replies are /sendas (each renders and commits a boundary). Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts run <lane> --evidence -- scripts/debug/so-open-stretch-check.mts (SO_STRETCH_SCENARIOS=test/scenarios/v28-19-open-opening.json). The start anchor opens free for 3 player turns. Asserts: the opening line and no objective line, and the current-checkpoint macro naming the scene only, at 1 and 2 player turns (a group round counts one); the ordinary objective line and the macro with the objective from the 3rd; a swipe keeps the state; deleting the 3rd player line reopens the opening; sending it again closes it.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s)`); return { cleared: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const read = () => ({ turns: rt.getPlayerTurns(), block: String(SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_guidance?.value ?? ''), macro: SillyTavern.getContext().substituteParams('{{story_current_checkpoint}}') }); globalThis.__so19 = { read, check: (turns, want) => { const now = read(); const shown = JSON.stringify(now.block.slice(-420)); if (now.turns !== turns) throw new Error(`expected ${turns} player turns, read ${now.turns}`); (want.has ?? []).forEach((text) => { if (!now.block.includes(text)) throw new Error(`the block lacks ${JSON.stringify(text)} at ${turns} turns: ${shown}`); }); (want.hasNot ?? []).forEach((text) => { if (now.block.includes(text)) throw new Error(`the block holds ${JSON.stringify(text)} at ${turns} turns: ${shown}`); }); if (want.macro !== undefined && now.macro !== want.macro) throw new Error(`the macro reads ${JSON.stringify(now.macro)} at ${turns} turns`); return { turns, macro: now.macro, tail: now.block.slice(-160) }; } }; return { ready: true };

const state = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState(); if (state?.activeCheckpointId !== 'harbour') throw new Error(`the story did not start on the anchor: ${state?.activeCheckpointId}`); return { active: state.activeCheckpointId };

return globalThis.__so19.check(2, {"has":["Open start: there is no task yet."],"hasNot":["Objective:","Persuade the harbour master"],"macro":"The harbour"});

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; const reply = ctx.chat[last]; if (reply.is_user) throw new Error('the last message is not a reply'); reply.swipes = ['She changes the subject.', reply.mes]; reply.swipe_id = 1; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); await ctx.swipe.left(); if (ctx.chat[last].swipe_id !== 0) throw new Error(`the swipe did not move to the existing alternative: ${ctx.chat[last].swipe_id}`); return { swiped: last };

return globalThis.__so19.check(3, {"has":["Objective: Persuade the harbour master to open the gate."],"hasNot":["Open start: there is no task yet."],"macro":"The harbour — Persuade the harbour master to open the gate."});

return globalThis.__so19.check(2, {"has":["Open start: there is no task yet."],"hasNot":["Objective:"],"macro":"The harbour"});
